t: The Hager Sollysta WMP2FO 20A unswitched flex outlet offers a secure and reliable electrical connection for fixed appliances. With a raised slim profile and a screwed faceplate, this electrical accessory requires a 25mm back box for installation. Angled in-line terminals with backed-out captive screws provide straightforward wiring. The 20A plate includes 2 x separate terminals for Line, Neutral, and Earth, enhancing safety and installation. A protective red washer prevents cable damage.
b: Angled In-Line Terminals with Backed-Out Captive Screws
